dataset.labeling: Manual labels over the current 100-candidate seeded database.

formulas.name: Semantic only
formulas.notes: Pure pgvector similarity over the retrieved pool. Lowest latency, weakest on exact skills.

formulas.name: RRF only
formulas.notes: Uses keyword+semantic Reciprocal Rank Fusion order, without profile-level evidence.

formulas.name: Old lexical blend
formulas.notes: The previous live scoring shape. The query-specific chat/system boost has been removed from the shared helper.

formulas.name: Balanced lexical
formulas.notes: No query-specific hack. Keeps semantic similarity dominant but rewards explicit skills and document term coverage.

formulas.name: Skill first
formulas.notes: Recruiter-style formula. Best when the query names concrete skills; riskier for vague semantic queries.

formulas.name: Phrase/proximity
formulas.notes: Generic phrase and nearby-term evidence, replacing the special chat/system hack.

formulas.name: Candidate evidence
formulas.notes: Balanced candidate-level evidence across profile fields, documents, skill match, and experience.

formulas.name: Strict recruiter
formulas.notes: Aggressively prioritizes explicit skill coverage and requested document type.
